uses_real.note: Cultivated ornamental with RHS Award of Garden Merit cultivars.

description.value: Pampas grass: a flowering grass with razor-sharp leaf margins, native to southern South America and widely grown as an ornamental.
description.quote: It is referred to by the common name pampas grass

native_range.value: Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay (southern South America, including the Pampas)
native_range.quote: The native range of C. selloana includes Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay

introduced_range.value: Widely distributed throughout the world as a cultivated ornamental and invasive species.
introduced_range.quote: It is widely distributed throughout the world as a cultivated ornamental and invasive species

environment.value: Moist soil in riparian areas with plentiful light and soil moisture; lower, moister sites than C. jubata.
environment.quote: typically restricted to moist soil within riparian areas
